question: On what ground does the manifold universe possess reality in the Supreme Lord?
premises: The Supreme Lord serves as the ultimate ground of all manifestation.
The universe appears in manifold and diverse forms.
Reality is affirmed of what is grounded in the Supreme Lord.
inference: Therefore, even in its manifold forms, the universe possesses reality alone through the Supreme Lord.
uncertainties: satyatā may be read as reality, truth, or realness depending on doctrinal emphasis.
plain_english: For the Supreme Lord, even the universe in all its manifold forms is reality alone.
